assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original fine-art Chinese ink-and-mineral-color painting background for a native interactive application. Wide landscape 16:9 composition. Bamboo garden in spring: expressive calligraphic ink bamboo and malachite green leaves frame the far left and right edges, softly layered pale bamboo in atmospheric middle distance, a few ochre scholar rocks near the lower corners, subtle rice-paper texture with luminous warm ivory empty space. Reserve a calm uncluttered central stage, center 35%-65% width and 30%-90% height, for a full-body standing character to be composited later; empty pale ground at lower middle, no foreground branches across this area. Museum-quality hand-painted Chinese xieyi brushwork, variation of wet/dry ink, beautiful sophisticated jade greens and warm light, intentional negative space. This should look like Chinese painting, not a photograph, digital blur filter, anime, vector or 3D art. No people, animals, lettering, calligraphy, seals, logos, frames, UI, borders or watermark. One complete painting, not a collage.
